title: Is there telemetry? if so, how could we opt-out?
body:
Hello, i am on the waitlist and just wondering what kind of telemetry is collected when using claude-code, and how it could be opted out of if it exists.

I checked the docs and License, it seems like the legal frameworks says information can be collected, just wondering since its a general commercial license.

Many thanks.
